responsibility: Provides the higher-level C++ compatibility header that exposes SPU intrinsic names but implements them on PPU/VMX by forwarding to si2vmx.h helpers or native AltiVec operations. It overloads many spu_* vector arithmetic, logical, compare, shuffle, splat, and memory functions for PowerPC vector types, letting SPU-oriented source code be retargeted onto VMX-capable processors with familiar intrinsic names.
